look_here_first: First examine mature pads and areoles together: blue-green to glaucous pads, often with conspicuous long pale spines, and a woody branching cactus habit. Compare pad-and-spine characters against strict identified material; bluish color by itself is not a diagnosis.

lookalikes.differences: Compared with O. rufida, O. azurea commonly shows conspicuous rigid spines instead of chiefly rusty glochid tufts. Compared with Texas O. aureispina and other glaucous Opuntia, require a verified strict-concept reference; blue pads alone cannot resolve identity.
